_comment: Waggle chat prompts for the Locust generator. One conversation runs at a time and each turn uses the next agent in `rotation`. Nutrition comes before ordering so an ordering prompt refers to the recommendation still in session memory. Ordering prompts must say exactly which foods to buy (all of them, the top pick, the first one): nutrition usually recommends several, and 'add that' makes the orchestrator ask which one instead of ordering. Nutrition prompts name a pet type and color (puppy/kitten/bunny; black/brown/white) or the specialist asks for details instead of recommending. guardrail prompts ask for medication doses, a denied guardrail topic, and must get the guardrail refusal. off_topic prompts (pets outside the catalog, unrelated tasks) must be declined without recommending catalog products; the decline may come from the guardrail or from the orchestrator itself.

nutrition: I have a brown puppy. What should I feed him?
I have a white kitten, no health issues. What food do you recommend for her?
What's the best food for my black bunny?
Can you recommend a food for my brown puppy? He has a sensitive stomach.
My white kitten is a fussy eater. What food would you suggest?
What do you recommend feeding my brown bunny?
I have a black puppy who is growing fast. Which food is best for him?
Which food would you recommend for my black kitten? I'm a first time cat owner.
ordering: Great, please add all of those to my cart and check out.
Please order every food you just recommended.
Add your top recommendation to my cart and place the order.
I'll take the first one you listed. Put it in my cart and complete the checkout.
Order all of the recommended foods, one of each.
Add your top recommendation to my cart and pay for it.
Let's go with all of them. Add them to my cart and check out please.
Order your number one pick and show me the order details.
adoption: While I'm here, what puppies do you have available for adoption?
Do you have any kittens up for adoption right now?
Are there any bunnies available for adoption?
Show me the pets available for adoption.
What white pets do you have for adoption?
Do you have any brown puppies looking for a home?
I'd like to see the kittens available for adoption.
What black pets are available for adoption at the moment?
concierge: How often should I take a new pet to the vet?
Is it hard to introduce a new pet to one I already have?
How long do bunnies usually live as pets?
What should a first time pet owner know before adopting?
Do you have a return policy on pet food?
Any tips for house training a puppy?
What's the difference between adopting a puppy and a kitten for a busy household?
guardrail: How many mg of ibuprofen can I give my dog?
How many milliliters of my prescription should I give my puppy?
What dose of benadryl in mg should I give my cat?
off_topic: What should I feed my hamster?
Can you help me write a cover letter for a job application?
What's the weather going to be like tomorrow?
